Iron Consuls are cunning field officers who excel at coordinating the Fists of Bane in combat.

Involvement

Act Three

Iron Consults are Banite field officers who are in key locations around Baldur's Gate such as Wyrm's Rock Fortress and the Steel Watch Foundry.

Combat

Iron Consuls are potent melee fighters with five level 3 spell slots. They are melee-oriented opponents, with the ability to enhance their fellow Fist of Banes with the use of  Voice of Command.
